items.headline: $XTEN Locks Final Airdrop Rate as Xpoints End
items.summary:
$XTEN locks its final airdrop rate as Xpoints end, putting the token launch in focus; early testers also earned bonus points.

items.headline: $ZEC's NU7 Goes Live, Cutting Block Times Threefold
items.summary: $ZEC activates NU7 on mainnet, cutting block times threefold and removing 60% of transaction fees from circulation via its Network Sustainability Mechanism.

items.headline: $ONDO Plans Tokenized Anthropic Shares From IPO Day
items.summary: $ONDO plans share-backed Anthropic notes for eligible non-US investors from IPO day, expanding its tokenized stocks push beyond valuation derivatives.

items.headline: $INJ Staking ETF Debuts on Nasdaq
items.summary: Canary's staked $INJ ETF begins trading on Nasdaq, giving investors token exposure plus staking rewards reflected in NAV.

items.headline: $GNO's Gnosis Pay Confirms Customer Data Breach
items.summary: Gnosis Pay says unauthorized access to its legacy consumer-card system exposed customer data, but funds and its enterprise platform were unaffected.
